limitations: Actual modules with synthetic intercepted fetch/KV/DO/D1/SDK seams; no external traffic or customer data.

Public error bodies, other service/route/scheduled/DO logs, historical data/disposition, consent/retention/access/datasets and full W07/customer/deployed/SLO/release acceptance remain open.
